revisions.text: You're in pain, Victor, more than you ever let on, more than any could ever know. But it need not be the case. Complete the ritual and let me be a balm to soothe you.
You're in pain Victor, more than you ever let on, more than any could ever know.  But it need not be the case.  Complete the ritual, and let our Mother be a balm to soothe you.
